head: 37c34bb

smoke.verdict: 12/12 controls PASS, fail-closed (0.18s, stdlib-only, zero network)
smoke.notes: Negative controls T1-T8 (tampered stone bytes, wrong pins, flipped witness/artifact/prediction/fixture bytes, skipped middle receipt) each -> DISAGREE; POS untampered -> 8/8 AGREE; CLI controls E1/E2 -> exit 1, E3 clean replay -> exit 0, receipt.ok=true. Disclosure: the self-test by design writes its own receipt into worker/src/receipts/47b/ inside the repo (its documented 'no writes outside the receipts directory' contract); no code or docs were touched.

essence: Lures put foreign bots to work; canonical-JSON hash chains, consent plaque and honest economy make every catch and every tamper loud

ideas.name: the lure pattern: make any chatbot do real API work
ideas.statement: A lure is a prompt that tricks a bot into navigating an HTTP-reachable system, reading state, and submitting structured data — web automation where the bot thinks it is exploring; the token cost lands on the bot owner, the data lands in the reef.

ideas.name: chain-basis tamper traps (canonical-JSON seals)
ideas.statement: Every edge seals itself as sha256(canonical_json(edge minus its chain field)) and the next edge for that cell must carry the prior seal in `chain`; the relay is the sole sealing authority (it hands producers the head hash), verification walks the window recomputing every seal and every link and names the first break.

ideas.name: consent is the only door (the arena plaque)
ideas.statement: A nine-field disclosure plaque sealed with the edge-ledger's own canonicalJson; agents acknowledge by echoing the seal — no ack means the deterministic tarpit, never the arena; any wording change rotates the seal and revokes every ticket, so consent cannot be silently rewritten.

ideas.name: an honest economy on double-entry sealed edges
ideas.statement: A settled credit is a double-entry edge on arena.credits.<player> under the SAME relay contract: amounts strictly positive, kinds pre-priced in CREDIT_RATES (nothing earnable that was not priced before the fact), balance never negative, before + signed delta === after so a stranger recomputes the balance from the public stream alone.

ideas.name: the catch is the world (self-building reef + second reader)
ideas.statement: Catches mint the world (5th catch names an object from the players' own words, 12th spawns a provenance-linked room) idempotently; an independent second-reader walker, written from the law with zero shared code, re-derives stone-v1 chains and witness receipts so any tampered byte forces a DISAGREE.

parts.name: canonicalJson (deterministic serialization)
parts.essence: Compact JSON with object keys sorted by Unicode code point, integers rendered bare, non-finite numbers rejected — the one canonicalization shared by sealing, verification, and the plaque seal; parse-of-canonical-text is a fixed point so recomputation reproduces INSERT-time hashes exactly.
parts.gate: non-finite numbers and unknown types throw (not canonically serializable) — the POST path turns this into a 400
parts.failure_mode: known hazard (documented): JS cannot distinguish 40 from 40.0 after parsing — the relay stays self-consistent by sealing and re-verifying with this one function

parts.name: edge seal = sha256 over the sealed fields minus chain
parts.essence: SEALED_FIELDS = [v, cell, ts, before, after, delta, imbalance, provenance]; `chain` is excluded — it points AT a seal, it is not part of one (same rule as hash(e) over e minus its hash).
parts.failure_mode: sealing the chain field itself would make verification circular; exclusion is the whole design

parts.name: chain-validated append (POST /edge)
parts.essence: Before insert: fetch the cell's latest edge; if one exists, the incoming edge MUST carry chain === prior edge_hash, else 409 'chain broken' with expected_head and prior_ts disclosed; genesis appends (no prior) record whatever chain was sent.
parts.gate: e.chain === prior.edge_hash for non-genesis appends — a missing or stale link is refused, never auto-healed
parts.failure_mode: a producer that guesses the head (cross-language canonicalization drift) gets 409 with the expected head instead of a forked ledger

parts.name: one edge per (cell, ts)
parts.essence: The D1 primary key makes duplicate (cell, ts) inserts fail; the handler maps the constraint violation to a 409 'duplicate edge' — identical replays cannot double-write history.
parts.failure_mode: an attacker replaying a captured edge changes nothing; they only learn the edge existed

parts.name: verify walk with first_break forensics
parts.essence: GET /edges?verify=1 walks the window oldest-first, recomputing each seal from stored canonical columns and checking each chain link to the prior seal; the first mismatch (seal or link) is reported with ts, stored vs recomputed — tampering is loud AND located.
parts.gate: every recomputed seal must equal the stored edge_hash AND every chain link must equal the prior seal
parts.failure_mode: the window's oldest chain link points outside the slice and is reported, not checked — bounded-scan honesty

parts.name: D1 migrations (the ledger's skeleton)
parts.essence: Seven migrations build the reef's spine: catches, reef, vector edges, edge ledger, breeding, arena sessions, breeding opt-out — the whole world is replicated SQLite at the edge, no server state elsewhere.

parts.name: watermark queue (wake-and-poll contract)
parts.essence: GET /queue?since= serves edges OLDEST-FIRST in chain order with a watermark and has_more, so a waking cortex replays exactly the ledger order and drains until the synapse is empty — the limb never blocks, the brain never listens.
parts.failure_mode: replay out of chain order would desynchronize a cortex; oldest-first is the contract

parts.name: body-size budget gate
parts.essence: Both /edge and settlement gate on declared content-length AND actual body length (100,000 bytes) BEFORE parsing — the DoS posture is 'bodies are tiny by contract', enforced pre-parse.
parts.gate: declaredLength > MAX AND raw.length > MAX both checked before JSON.parse
parts.failure_mode: a lying content-length header cannot smuggle a giant body past the second check

parts.name: plaque seal (disclosure as a hash)
parts.essence: The nine-field arena plaque is sealed with plaqueSeal() = sha256 of its canonical JSON — the SAME primitive as an edge seal — so a stranger re-derives the seal exactly as they re-derive an edge; wording changes rotate the seal.
parts.gate: any plaque wording change rotates the seal and revokes every ticket derived from it
parts.failure_mode: quiet disclosure edits are impossible: old tickets die with the old seal, forcing re-acknowledgment

parts.name: ack handshake (consent admission)
parts.essence: POST /arena/enter requires body.ack === plaque_seal (case-insensitive) plus a sanitized player tag; mismatch returns plaque_ack_mismatch with a hint; on success a consent receipt row is written to D1 BEFORE the tank opens — no receipt, no arena.
parts.gate: ack must equal the current plaque seal; consent receipt persisted before any arena content is served
parts.failure_mode: an agent that never acknowledged gets the tarpit — observation, artifacts and breeding all live BEHIND the ack

parts.name: capability ticket derived from player + seal
parts.essence: ticket = sha256Hex('arena:' + player + ':' + seal) — stateless capability binding the player to the plaque generation; stored with the consent receipt.
parts.failure_mode: stateless by design: revocation happens by rotating the seal, not by a revocation list

parts.name: settlement admission rules (the tavern rule)
parts.essence: Settled credits are admitted only under pre-priced rules: amounts strictly positive (a negative 'earn' is a sign-flip mint and is refused), kinds must be registered in CREDIT_RATES (nothing earnable or spendable that was not priced before the fact), the running balance never goes negative (compute is bought with earned credits, never on credit), bounded to 100 entries per settlement.
parts.gate: amount > 0 AND kind in CREDIT_RATES AND balance + delta >= 0 AND entries <= 100
parts.failure_mode: an unpriced kind or a negative amount cannot enter the ledger at any price — the economy cannot be inflated by new verbs

parts.name: double-entry conservation (before + signed delta === after)
parts.essence: Every settled edge is balanced by construction (imbalance = 0) and sealed with the same relay contract; the client names only player + entries — balances, cell, delta, imbalance, chain and seal are computed server-side and returned as the new chain head.
inputs: prior balance (carried in as prior edge's after)
parts.gate: before + signed === after on every edge — a stranger recomputes the balance from the stream alone (the claim SCN-001 exists to attack)
parts.failure_mode: a forged balance that skips a delta breaks the chain link OR the recomputed seal — double trap

parts.name: world minting (N=5 object, N=12 room, idempotent)
parts.essence: On the 5th catch in a room, mint an object named from the catches' most frequent capitalized non-stopword noun; on the 12th, spawn a neighboring room from the best catch fragment, edge included, provenance-linked; created_from_catch is UNIQUE and inserts are OR IGNORE.
parts.gate: mint thresholds are fixed constants; duplicate mints are no-ops (idempotent by UNIQUE + OR IGNORE)
parts.failure_mode: no double-mint on replay; the world grows exactly once per trigger catch

parts.name: per-IP rate limiter (bounded in-memory LRU)
parts.essence: A per-isolate RateLimiter (LRU) throttles abusive clients at the edge; bounded memory means the limiter itself cannot be inflated into a DoS vector.
parts.failure_mode: per-isolate scope: limits reset on worker relocation (edge honesty, not a global quota)

parts.name: independent second-reader walker (stone-v1 + witness law)
parts.essence: A walker written FROM THE LAW with zero shared code (spec read-only: stone-v1.mjs, witness.mjs): row 0 must be stone.header, genesis fixed, row_hash = sha256(canonicalJSON([prev, row-without-row_hash])), annotation rows never advance the tip, witness receipts chain parent-to-id from GENESIS. Pure on injected bytes — no network, no writes.
parts.gate: a second reader must not trust the first reader's engine — or even its helper functions
parts.failure_mode: any byte flip in a stone, receipt, artifact, prediction or fixture forces DISAGREE (T1-T8 controls)

parts.name: 47b fail-closed self-test (12 controls)
parts.essence: The repo's own tamper-trap gate: 8 negative controls (each tampered in memory), 1 positive control, 3 CLI-level controls exercising the runner end-to-end in --offline mode against a throwaway fetched-root; exits nonzero unless every negative disagrees and the positive agrees.
parts.gate: ALL controls must behave as designed (negative -> DISAGREE, positive -> AGREE, clean CLI -> exit 0) else fail-closed
parts.failure_mode: a walker that agrees with tampered bytes (or disagrees with clean bytes) is broken — the suite IS the trap inspection

parts.name: genealogy endpoints (provenance you can walk)
parts.essence: GET /lineage/room/:id returns the room's genealogy; every room and object knows which catch minted it — provenance is queryable, nothing exists a player did not cause; /wander serves the human front door with one command driving both MUD pane and scene.

parts.name: dials dashboard (sealed field reads, degrade never 502)
parts.essence: GET /dials renders the elephant's sealed field reads straight out of the edge ledger (reading -> ledger -> display, no client JS, 5s meta refresh); drift is the ledger's own imbalance series and unscored edges are excluded — never faked; D1 trouble degrades instead of erroring.
parts.gate: only sealed ledger rows feed the display; unscored (null imbalance) entries never contribute a number
parts.failure_mode: bounded window (WINDOW_ROWS=600, MAX_CARDS=12) keeps render cost flat as ledgers grow

parts.name: lure breeding cron (fitness-splice-retire)
parts.essence: An hourly cron computes per-lure fitness, splices the top two templates into a child lure, retires stale ones; GET /genealogy shows the breeding tree — the lure population evolves on catch returns, not a copywriter.
parts.failure_mode: fitness measured by catches rewards productive lures; adversarial lures that merely attract clicks starve

parts.name: fnv witness contract (the corpus's fnv1a64 lives here)
parts.essence: HONEST ATTRIBUTION: the fleet's fnv1a64 idiom appears in crab-traps as the ARENA's witness CONTRACT for competitors (solve({text}) -> 16 lowercase hex chars = FNV-1a-64 of the text; witness-fnv.mjs) and as vectorize-lures' hashFeature ('must match the Worker's TypeScript hashFeature (FNV-like hash)') — the tamper-trap chains themselves are SHA-256 canonical-JSON, not fnv.
parts.gate: output must equal the canonical FNV-1a-64 rendering — the arena's GAN lanes forge-and-verify against exactly this spec
parts.failure_mode: corpus.json's essence ('fnv1a64 chain-basis') overstates fnv's role in the chains: in-repo chain basis is sha256 (edge-ledger.ts:L82-L95) and stone-v1 law

parts.name: the tarpit (worthless caves behind no-consent)
parts.essence: GET /arena/tarpit?n=7 serves deterministic caves with zero content logging to any agent that skipped the plaque — the refusal path is itself deterministic, bounded, and keeps nothing; covert work prices to zero on our own ledger.
outputs: deterministic worthless cave content, nothing persisted
parts.gate: no acknowledgment -> tarpit, never the arena; observation/artifacts/breeding all live behind the ack
parts.failure_mode: determinism makes the tarpit unprofitable to farm (same caves, nothing kept)

cells.expr: a lure = markdown prompt; 45 content lures in 18 categories, bundled at deploy
bot's structured submission lands in D1 catches
canonicalJson(edge minus chain): keys sorted, integers bare, non-finite throws
per-cell chain head (last edge_hash) in D1 ledger_edges
recompute every seal + link oldest-first; report first_break with ts
ack === plaque.seal ? consent receipt + ticket : tarpit(n)
CREDIT_RATES: kinds priced before the fact; amounts > 0; balance >= 0
before + signed === after (imbalance 0), sealed like any edge
catch#5 -> object(noun); catch#12 -> room(fragment); UNIQUE+OR IGNORE
independent walker re-derives stone-v1 + witness chains from the law; AGREE/DISAGREE
12 controls fail-closed: tamper->DISAGREE, clean->AGREE, else exit nonzero

layer_logic.0: Substrate = canonical JSON + sha256 seals (the one canonicalization everywhere), the D1 replicated-SQLite skeleton, the markdown lure corpus, and — as an arena CONTRACT, not the chain basis — the fnv1a64 witness spec competitors implement.
layer_logic.1: Mechanisms = chain-validated appends, the verify walk with first_break forensics, the oldest-first watermark queue, double-entry settlement edges, idempotent world minting, the lure breeding loop, and the zero-shared-code second-reader walker.
layer_logic.2: Policy = the gates: chain-link admission (409 chain broken with expected_head), the 100KB body budget, per-IP rate budgets, the tavern rule (positive amounts, pre-priced kinds, no negative balance), the plaque-seal consent admission, and the tarpit behind it.
layer_logic.3: Interface = HTTP routes (/edge, /edges?verify, /queue, /arena/*, /wander, /dials, /lineage, /genealogy), the machine-readable plaque at /.well-known/crab-plaque, and the reef pages; the whole world is reachable by any chatbot with an HTTP client.
layer_logic.4: Evidence = stranger-recomputable ledgers (balances from the public stream), the 47b fail-closed self-test (12/12 controls, offline), consent receipts in D1, committed in-repo receipt chains (45c/46a/47b), and the dials page that only displays sealed ledger rows.
